notes: Explicit full GC only outside timed calls/batches; same collector and settings for all builds
Heap pool peak sum is a conservative sum of per-pool peaks, not a simultaneous heap peak
RSS and private memory per stage sampled; OS lifetime peaks also recorded
Same JVM runs all families, then 4 warmup and 32 measured four-worker batches of 8 requests
Bounded soak checks retention; does not prove absence of all leaks
Threshold flags are screening aids, not proof of equivalence or no leaks
Two isolated forks per build, reverse build order; other host activity can vary timings
2 warmups/5 repeats for families, 4/8 for stress cases; resource stress figures do not replace high-warmup latency measurements
